payload.blocks: Phase 3 land, and through it phases 2, 4, 5 and 6 (all depend on phase 3).
payload.headline: Widen phase 3's footprint by the generated command-manifest.json?

parts.cause: command-manifest.json is generated from the registry by scripts/export-command-selectors.mjs. Any registry change must regenerate it in the same commit. I checked with --check: only the manifest drifts, command-routes.json does not. My earlier question missed this generated file.

options.cost: One footprint commit by the supervisor plus one unit, about 15 minutes.
options.does: Add packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-manifest.json to the plan and phase 3 footprint; one unit regenerates it with node scripts/export-command-selectors.mjs (no hand edit), reruns the tests, then review and land phase 3.
options.gain: Acceptance 4 holds end to end, and host help shows the --role form.
options.harm: The manifest is shared by every plan that touches the registry; a later registry change must rebase over it.
options.label: Widen by the generated manifest

options.cost: A follow-up item and a later plan.
options.does: Revert the bin/fgos.mjs and registry edits, land phase 3 with the outcome values only, and open a backlog row for the short-role stop.
options.harm: Real wakes still fail to stop a short-role lead (recorded as stop-failed); acceptance 4 is met only in fixtures.
options.label: Drop the --role flag from phase 3

parts.recommendation: Widen by the manifest: it is a generated projection of the registry change the owner already approved, and no hand edit is involved.

scope.allows: Adding exactly packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-manifest.json to the footprint and changing it only by regenerating it with scripts/export-command-selectors.mjs.
scope.forbids: Hand edits to the manifest, any other generated contract, or other plans' footprints.

parts.what: Per q-qzchcwl7ya the unit added the --role property to the session stop entry of src/cli/command-registry.mjs (worktree 261124-2143-head-lifecycle-events-p03c, uncommitted with the two earlier edits). Two tests in test/rust-host/command-routes.test.mjs now fail on drift: the committed packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-manifest.json is no longer the registry's projection. The Rust host embeds that manifest for help (apps/fgos/src/help.rs).
